repos_data.description: Open-source coding agent memory. Records issues, attempts, fixes and decisions, then warns your agent before it repeats an approach that already failed. Native MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity and Codex. 100% local, no cloud, no telemetry. MIT.

Persistent, verified memory for coding agents — so they stop re-explaining your codebase and never act on stale knowledge. Every memory is checked against your actual code; lives in your repo as plain files, shared via git. No account, no DB. Install: npx -y @kage-core/kage-graph-mcp install
Tentra MCP — memory for AI coding agents. Persistent code graph + AI architecture diagrams. 32 MCP tools. Works in Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Windsurf.
Persistent memory for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor) — past bugs & fixes, decisions, and your corrections, as plain files in your repo.
Shared memory MCP server for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor). Free & local by default.
Durable, local-first memory for AI coding agents over MCP — zero-dependency, curated & semantically de-duped, you own the data (SQLite + Markdown). Works with Claude Code, Codex & any MCP host.
Local task-state ledger for AI coding agents. Preserve decisions, source conclusions, evidence, and checkpoints across Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and other MCP clients.
Local, searchable project memory for AI coding agents. Markdown source of truth, MCP interface, safe structured updates — no cloud.
Open-source team memory layer for AI coding agents — markdown files in git, user→team→org hierarchy, cross-vendor MCP server. Apache-2.0.
Zero-configuration MCP server that unifies multiple AI coding assistants (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini) through intelligent auto-discovery and standardized interface
Local-first memory engine for AI-agent teams — private/team/project ACL, associative recall, federated sync, and a built-in MCP server. One SQLite file, no LLM required. Apache-2.0.
MCP server for searching AI agents, MCP servers, CLI tools and agent skills via A2ASearch
